_comment: Real components in the merged plugin repo (docs/loop.md). Browser phases run under M1's vc-lock (the login check on the host; the run component takes it INSIDE the container, listed in self_locking, so the lock lives as long as the in-container runner and not as long as the host's docker exec client, C-18); everything that talks to the browser runs inside the recorder container (bin/vc-env exec). The viewer review and the fixer are handed off to the orchestrator (docs/steps/review.md and the fixer subagent, on the models set by the review_model / fixer_model knobs); `"review": ["{root}/bin/vc-review", "headless", "{request}"]` runs the review with `claude -p` instead (unattended).
